caption: The gates of Eamonn Medley's Two-Mile-Borris Transport Museum dressed up for our Vintage Coffee Morning, with our pair of wooden planters either side echoing the cohesive village planter scheme. Eamonn opened the gates for the day and the museum became the focal point of the fundraiser (May 2026)

The newest piece in the collection. A full Bord na Móna locomotive (LM 335, a Hunslet-built 3-foot-gauge Wagonmaster that worked Littleton from 1980) and a stretch of track lifted from the now-retired Littleton bog and reassembled on site, saved from the scrap pile and now part of the museum's run of recent industrial heritage. From left: Eamonn Medley (museum owner), Ask Eamonn, Ask Eamonn (May 2026)

Inside the shed, with the 1962 Morris Oxford and the 1968 Morris Minor pulled out for visitors and a model Red Arrow hanging overhead. Eamonn has been quietly building this collection for years and it's a real treasure to behold. From left: Eamonn Medley (museum owner), Ask Eamonn, Ask Eamonn (May 2026)
